environment.description: Flask application deployed on an EC2 instance behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode on port 443). Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request filtering or inspection layer. SQLite database at /var/app/data/users.db contains production user records including api_key and password_hash columns. Application runs as ec2-user with full read/write on the database file.
